name: Dosukebe Ura Soap-jou ~JK Hen~ play.10 Scatolo Ninpu Shussan THE NOVEL
original_name: ドスケベ裏ソープ嬢～JK編～ play.10 スカトロ妊婦出産 THE NOVEL
source:
A pregnant JK on the day she's due to give birth.
The skin covering her bloated belly is tanned dark.
Her tattoos are signs of the countless encounters she's had with other men.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ394148.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一名懷孕的女高中生到了預產期。
她隆起的肚皮被太陽曬得黝黑。
身上的刺青見證了她與其他男人無數次的交歡。

［摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ394148.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
